author: Second Wind
description:
This video is brought to you by The Snackbar at the End of the World, a bittersweet story of love, defiance, and… pasta? Take over a struggling restaurant to save your family in this hand-drawn, narrative adventure RPG set in magical 1960s Italy. – https://store.steampowered.com/app/5211590/The_Snackbar_at_the_End_of_the_World/

Encounters should be balanced, engaging, and memorable. But how do you bake all that into a fight or a heist or some other encounter? Red from Overly Sarcastic Productions and Rolling with Difficulty and Jesse Galena talk about it and take your questions.

If you dig watching us check out indies, considering supporting us over at Patreon -- https://www.patreon.com/SecondWindGroup

title: Making Memorable Encounters w/ Red (OSP and Rolling with Difficulty) | RPG Help Desk
